free_tier.stated: Not free. The vendor sells VPS from EUR 2.45 a month: "VPS baratos en Espana desde 2,45 EUR/mes con hardware propio en Madrid, NVMe, IPv4 dedicada, trafico ilimitado". The domain name misleads the same way vpsFree.cz does.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: EUR 2.45 a month for a dedicated IPv4 with unmetered traffic in Madrid is a strong egress and IPv4 price, but it composes as a paid floor rather than as free capacity.
limits_note: There is no free tier at all: the cheapest product is EUR 2.45 a month, so the first euro is the first hour.
binding_note: There is no free tier at all: the cheapest product is EUR 2.45 a month, so the first euro is the first hour.

evidence.proved: front page prices four VPS families from EUR 2.45 a month with own hardware in Madrid, NVMe, a dedicated IPv4 and unmetered traffic, quoted from the Spanish page
a collected list of free VPS offers classifies vpsfree.es as a free IPv6-only 1 core 2 GB LXC host with no renewal requirement, which is the claim this record refutes

notes: Recorded because a widely copied Chinese list of free VPS hosts still lists this domain as a perpetual free IPv6 VM, and the live site sells paid VPS with no free lane. The two Spanish hosts that use a free-sounding name, vpsfree.es and vpsFree.cz, are both paid, which is why neither belongs in a free-tier table.
